# Spirit Magi Growth + stages

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified

## Derived / confirmed formula

Growth = 100 (Stage 1) + Initial Growth mods, clamped 100-1000; one Stage per 100 Growth (max 5 at 500). Per 8 Growth: +1% Physique. Per stage: +10% additional Skill Area. Stage 2 +30% Enhanced chance; Stage 3 Enhanced stronger; Stage 4 Empower stronger; Stage 5 +50% additional dmg.
